crossRefs.note: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t…
For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works…
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…
for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from…

translations.web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
translations.bsb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
translations.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
translations.asv: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
